title: ACIS-history proxy direct index
scope: Remove a redundant per-proxy vector allocation from ACIS-history proxy graph indexing.
Preserve duplicate-handle, owner, class identity, graph closure, and serialized output behavior.

sourceChange.before: Index each proxy handle to a vector, reject duplicate keys before insertion, append exactly one pointer, and perform a second map lookup to find that pointer.
sourceChange.after: Reserve a handle-to-proxy-pointer map, reject duplicate/zero handles on insertion, and directly resolve the unique pointer during graph traversal.
sourceChange.effect: Removes one small vector allocation and an extra hash lookup per proxy; preserves the existing missing/duplicate/wrong-owner graph rejection and catches index allocation failure as a rejected graph.

focusedTests.coverageNote: Existing generated DWG round-trip owner covers AC1027 proxy-history closure projection and duplicate-handle, mixed-class, and malformed-edge refusal cases.

validation.diffCheck: passed for dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Advances the 7S.2c per-route allocation/repeated-work audit without changing feature support, serialization semantics, test cadence, compatibility, or external qualification requirements. The broader implementation goal remains active.

testsRun: Strict local DWG round-trip test target build

method.limitations: The change removes a redundant per-proxy small-vector allocation and lookup. It does not measure allocator overhead or process RSS and does not establish whole-process resource bounds.
